entries.title: Andor King & Queen
entries.summary: Coordinate a two-phase encounter at the bottom of Andor.
notes: Both bosses use Cursed Tune and attacks that can pierce dion. The King favors range; the Queen pursues in melee. The source recommends an 80,000-health tank.
The group is saved when the King spawns. A player who was offline or outside the group at that moment can accidentally summon another King by attacking the platform Queen.
Chest quantities are not guaranteed; reports of zero to three Queen chests are anecdotal.
Additional source credit: Viral — encounter notes.
steps: Reach Andor 140 with an ability 40+ group. Hide from a pure Archer, or the entrance and halfway NPC services, can assist the descent. Everyone must be present to enter. Prepare aite and fas before the encounter.
Place the tank at (9,6), with the group to the right. Attack the Queen on the platform to summon the King. He retreats four tiles from the tank to (9,10).
Defeat the King with sustained healing and mana support. Use Cursed Tunes, Frost Arrow, Shock Arrow, and mor pian na dion, or use curse and fas with an Archer’s light attacks.
Have a different group member attack the platform Queen. During this phase, offensive players should stand beside her to reduce teleporting.
Defeat the Queen to return outside Andor. Each boss offers its own chest chance.

entries.title: Andor Queen Directions
entries.summary: Follow the room sequence to the Andor Queen on floor 140.
notes: The source expresses directions with arrow images. Those images must be interpreted and checked before replacing them with textual directions.
steps: Use the route’s arrows to choose the wall containing the upward exit in each room.
Floors 70 and 80 provide safe rooms before the later part of the route.
Prepare for the Queen before entering floor 140.

entries.title: Archer fieldcraft
entries.summary: A mechanics-focused digest of Tourne’s Archer guide: choose between light spell damage, prepared strikes, and control according to the target.
notes: Tourne’s guide is a historical source. Its cooldown estimates and personal class ratings are not treated as measured current values. Vorlof’s ability tables take precedence where they provide values.

The Shock Arrow paragraph says 1% of current health, but its 100,000,000-health example incorrectly gives 100,000 damage. One percent is 1,000,000. This arithmetic inconsistency is retained here rather than used to create a formula.
Additional source credit: Tourne — original Archer guide.
steps: Use Star Arrow against suitable dark-defense targets. Strength supports Assassin Strike, Rear Strike, Arrow Shot, and Special Arrow Attack; Intelligence supports Star Arrow. Check the target’s actual elements before choosing a necklace.

Prepare a curse-and-fas window before a heavy strike. Assassin Strike is an opener; Rear Strike follows the same attack-history restriction and reaches up to five tiles in the source guide. Amnesia, Breislich, or a poison trap can reset the documented attack condition. Amnesia requires a suitable weapon and adjacent positioning.

Equip a bow for Arrow Shot. Special Arrow Attack also needs ammunition in the first inventory slot. Arrow Shot’s rank affects damage and range; its trained level affects success. Star Arrow’s trained level affects damage as well.
Use Frost Arrow to slow movement, attacks, regeneration, and frequent debuff removal. Use Shock Arrow against high-current-health bosses, with mana support ready.

Treat the ability 40, 50, and 60 choices as separate decisions: Shadow Strike/Pitfall Trap, Birthday Suit/Incapacitate, and Supernova/Precision Strike. The equipment-removal pair has player-state restrictions and does not work on monsters.

entries.title: Arena
entries.summary: Arena combat emphasizes coordinated bursts, effect control, and positioning.
notes: Vorlof describes “heal-out” timing and simultaneous Kelberoth Strikes as player techniques. Their reliability depends on combat timing and server behavior; the source’s packet-level explanation is a contributor’s account, not verified server documentation.
steps: Coordinate damage skills into a short burst when a target is vulnerable. Sleep and Wolf Fang Fist can interrupt healing or hold a target while protective effects expire.
Wake disabled allies with a suitable weak attack. Keep healing and mana support available between offensive windows.
Watch armor class, curses, and elemental defense together. A cover curse may delay a stronger curse, while opponents can remove it before applying their preferred effect.
Use charge, ambush, throw, and body positioning to control who can reach the group’s vulnerable members.
Check the host’s rules before arranging a match; limits on shields or particular effects can change the tactics.

entries.title: Arena Host

steps: Use the separate Hosted Arena guide for documented hosting information.

entries.title: Armor Class
entries.summary: Armor class modifies incoming damage, with a documented effective range from −90 to 100.
notes: This is Vorlof’s player-tested model and does not claim that every ability follows it. The source credits Farnk’s testing.
Additional source credit: Farnk — armor-class testing.
steps: For the ordinary attacks covered by this model, use damage multiplier 1 + effective armor class ÷ 100, with armor class clamped between −90 and 100.
At −30 AC, the model gives 70% of unmodified damage. At −90 or lower it gives 10%; at 100 or above it gives 200%.
Additional armor below −90 can still offset curses that raise armor class. For example, −110 with beag cradh’s +20 remains at the −90 cap.

entries.title: Ascending
entries.summary: Exchange experience for permanent health or mana after qualifying for ascension.
notes: Being attackable can lead to equipment damage; remain attentive during the ritual. For two hours after using the hair, Vorlof documents a Warrior’s Rescue followed by Hemloch and Wine as a way to repeat the death step without another hair.
Master stat purchases consume 150 health per point. The source’s HP-per-4.29-billion table is approximate at the displayed rounded experience budget.
steps: Earn the required Aisling mark, such as Aisling of Talgonite. Obtain Succubus’s Hair from deep Mileth Crypt or another player.
Deposit any Warranty Bag before the ritual. Drop Succubus’s Hair at the Mileth altar (33,50), removing King Bruce’s protection and applying the visible death mask. Arrange the required in-game death.
Do not speak to the Death Mundane. Walk west into the rubble at (6,23), then to (4,20), to reach the ascension area.

Use the left temple for health or the right for mana. Choose “I stand in awe by the power of Deoch”, continue twice, then “I devote my life’s experience to Deoch” and “I prostrate again in the power of Deoch”.
Repeat the desired purchases. Leave through “I am not sure” and “I descend”.

entries.title: Client troubleshooting
entries.summary: Resolve several common client input and file-permission problems described by Vorlof.
notes: The source’s mouse-flicker and other-issues sections are placeholders without solutions. Third-party programs mentioned there are historical references, not software bundled or endorsed by this library.
steps: If the client cannot create its server table, use an installation folder where the user account can write files. The source also discusses administrator or compatibility modes, but those are not required by this library.
If Ctrl, Alt, or Shift seems stuck after switching windows, focus the game and tap each modifier once so the release is registered.
For a suspected position desynchronization, stop moving and press F5 before retrying a door or interaction.
If character creation is temporarily limited, allow the cooldown to expire rather than repeatedly attempting additional names.

entries.title: Dojo
entries.summary: Train skills and spells during an eight-hour Dojo session.
notes: Vorlof describes faster improvement inside the Dojo. Skill/Spell Leveling Bonus lasts one hour and continues counting down while you leave to learn another ability.
steps: Speak to Niomope at Mehadi Entrance, choose “Enter Training Dojo”, and pay 25,000 coins.

entries.title: Dracon
entries.summary: Finish Arsaidh Aon with a five-class group and artifact weapons.
notes: The source dialogue promises Replica weapon empowerment at ability 99; that statement is not evidence of a separately verified upgrade.
steps: Bring one member of each base class, each with the required Hy-brasyl artifact, to the bottom corner of East Woodland 20-1. Avoid the final bottom tile until everyone is ready. Warrior and Monk must equip their Replica weapons.
Group all five and step onto the bottom tile to reach Decimated Village. Immediately separate Warrior and Monk into their own two-person group: Dracon can kill a group of five in one attack.

Fight at (55,40). The stationary boss has dark attack and defense, uses Dragon Blast, and ignites nearby tiles. Curse it; use fas only when attacking with light. Warrior and Monk handle close attacks while other attackers stay at range. Keep healing, mana, and red support assigned.
When Dracon begins exploding and says “Arrrgh! Noooo!!”, quickly regroup Warrior and Monk with the original party before the death transfer.
At Unknown Plane, speak to Annsa and King Feasgar for Engagement Ring and Defeated Arsaidh Aon.

entries.title: Dung Boss
entries.summary: Survive repeated map-wide damage during Discovered Lost Ruins.
notes: The shock aura deals 20,000 damage across the map regardless of protective spells and can strike more than once per second. Other threats include cradh, immobilization, and dion-piercing attacks.
steps: Reach Lost Ruins 5 Altar during the ability 40+ quest. The source recommends at least 41,000 health. Prepare aite and fas for earth assails, along with dedicated red support, one or two group healers, mana restoration, and damage roles.
Stand group members on the circles and the last member on the altar. Spread immediately after the transfer.
Keep Frost Arrow and Cursed Tunes active while attacking with Shock Arrow, mor pian na dion, or Hail of Feathers. When using the latter, coordinate ard fas on the boss.

Deal with two of the three Dung Guards and consider leaving one alive to prevent another full summon. A surviving guard also increases boss regeneration, so this choice trades regeneration against fresh adds.
Defeating the boss returns the party to Lost Ruins 5.

steps: When a class is announced, enter the appropriate Mileth College classroom and take a seat. A teacher with an award above Clave can begin once enough students attend.
Follow the teacher’s instructions. Students are silenced during the lesson unless granted speaking permission.
After the class, move or refresh within a few minutes to claim credit. Attendance consumes four days of labor.
Accumulate three Educated marks to qualify for a contest entry.

entries.title: Elementism
entries.summary: Wizards use elemental fiors and leasaich spells to restore mana.
notes: Repeated harvesting can award the numbered Elementalist mark.
steps: Equip Nadurra Necklace and learn the leasaich spell matching the element you want to gather or consume.
Harvest fiors at the listed locations, or obtain them through a Rogue’s Black Market purchase for 500 coins each.
To restore mana, cast the matching leasaich spell, refresh, and accept the event. The necklace must remain equipped for the dialogue to appear.

entries.title: Elements
entries.summary: Match offense to an enemy’s defensive element and choose a belt suited to incoming damage.
notes: The source also lists positional damage multipliers of ×2 from the side and ×2.5 from behind. These mechanics should be considered separately from elemental advantage.
steps: A necklace sets the character’s offensive element; a belt sets defensive element. The basic advantage cycle is Fire over Wind, Wind over Earth, Earth over Water, and Water over Fire.
Vorlof lists a favorable basic matchup at 174% damage, an unfavorable one at 66%, and Dark against any basic element at 125%. Light has its advantage against Dark.
Dark and Light belts offer the same protection against basic elements, but differ when receiving Light or Dark attacks.

Nature strengthens the Wind pattern: stronger against Earth and more vulnerable to Fire. Metal strengthens the Fire pattern: stronger against Wind and more vulnerable to Water. Metal has no added advantage against Nature.
Use Martial Awareness, Combat Sense, or Study Creature to inspect defenses where available.

entries.title: Emotes
entries.summary: Use modifier keys and number keys to perform character emotes.
steps: Keep the character’s face visible and hold Ctrl, Alt, or Ctrl+Alt while pressing the mapped number.

entries.title: Enchantment
entries.summary: Wizards can enchant eligible base equipment with one of four documented effects.
notes: Magic adds mana and also cancels negative mana attributes on qualifying equipment. Random stats alone do not establish that an item can be enchanted.
steps: Check the chosen enchantment’s insight, location, material, and assisting-class requirements.
Bring the eligible base item and required participants to the correct magic shop.
Complete the enchantment and inspect the resulting item. The library keeps the modified name as an alias of its base entry.

entries.title: Experience and ability bonuses
entries.summary: Compare temporary reward bonuses and their documented sources.
notes: Vorlof documents stacking a regular double bonus with a corresponding shop double for a fourfold reward. Verify the exact item combination before consuming scarce bonuses.
steps: Choose a bonus appropriate to experience, ability, or both. The listed effects last one hour unless the item specifies otherwise.
Opening a bundle creates a stack that can no longer be traded.
Event availability and Kruna prices are source observations, not confirmation of a current offer.

steps: Activate one Experience Gem and select health or mana. A use covers one resource type.
Choose a bulk purchase or buy increments of 50 health or 25 mana. Costs match ordinary ascension.
Finish all desired purchases before closing the window. Reopening requires another gem.

entries.title: Experience Hunting
entries.summary: Use hunting experience for levels and, after level 99, permanent character growth.

steps: Choose a hunting area suitable for the character and group. Suggested levels are recommendations, not verified entry locks.
Account for group size and level gaps when comparing rewards. Vorlof documents a smaller group-experience reduction when all five classes are present.
After level 99, experience continues accumulating and can fund health or mana purchases and subsequent master stat purchases.

entries.title: Fire Serpent
entries.summary: Defeat the serpent for the quest’s Fire Serpent Skin.
steps: Enter with an ability 40+ group on Fire Serpent. Prepare aite but avoid fas on party members because Ring of Fire deals heavy light damage. The source recommends at least 40,000 health.
Have the tank summon and immediately attack the serpent. Keep the group close enough to red and heal while maintaining mana restoration.
Curse and fas the boss, then use wind attacks such as Keeter or Hail of Feathers. Its curses persist, but it drains group mana and can pierce dion.

entries.title: From Hy-brasyl to the Dark Ages
entries.summary: The setting’s origin traces a lost civilization, the misuse of elemental power, and the struggle between light and darkness.
notes: This is a brief reading guide to Seanchas Temuair, Volume 1. Consult the linked original for the complete literary work.
steps: Hy-brasyl’s prosperity ended as elemental knowledge became a source of domination and warfare. Its destruction scattered the survivors into new settlements.
Dark magic brought the dubhaimid and the realm ruled by Chadul. Danaan’s opposition established the central conflict between light and darkness.
Later struggles involved Tenes, the Anaman, Ainmeal, and the rise of Loures. Under Ealagad, the Shadows War led to the discovery of the element of light.

entries.title: From the Sewer
entries.summary: A From the Sewer encounter during the Loures Sewer Canal run.
steps: Reach Loures Sewer Canal 12 or 13; only one of these encounters is available per route and wait near the center. The spawn can take fifteen minutes.
Use pian na dion or mor pian na dion where available; other attackers may need a curse before using their strongest attacks.
The kill transfers the group to Loures Sewer Canal 1. Each group member has a chance at Big Canal Treasure Bag or Heavy Canal Treasure Bag.

entries.title: Gan
entries.summary: An ability 7+ boss in the Veltain Mines chain.
notes: The boss removes curses and responds to dion with ao sith. A tank with 80,000 health is a source recommendation, not an entry requirement.
steps: Prepare a group able to handle the mines, with fas, aite, and Dark Belt. One player entering transfers the whole group into the encounter.

Move south with the highest-health character leading to locate Gan. Keep group healing and mana restoration active, refresh curses after removal, and attack with summons, Hail of Feathers, or mor pian na dion.
Gan uses rapid Rumble damage, Dune Swipe against nearby players, and teleports to a target more than two tiles away.
Defeating Gan returns the group to the lobby. Each member can receive Heavy Veltain Chest.

entries.title: Gem Polishing
entries.summary: Rogues improve gems through Fragment, Uncut, Flawed, and Finished grades.
notes: If an assisted attempt finishes a Flawed gem with its first improvement, the second improvement can apply to the next most valuable eligible gem. Keeping different types and grades separate prevents unintended changes. Relogging is the source’s workaround if the process becomes stuck.
steps: Learn Gem Polishing and prepare labor. Separate unwanted gems because polishing selects the most valuable eligible gem in inventory.
Cast the spell, then drop one coin on the casting tile to open the polishing menu. Repeat the one-coin action for later attempts.
Alone, a successful attempt raises one grade and failure destroys the gem. With an assistant, success provides two grade improvements and failure does not destroy it.

For Uncut, polish fragments alone and remove each success after identifying it. For Flawed, polish fragments with an assistant and remove each success. For Finished, continue assisted polishing until the needed gems are complete.

entries.title: Gem Smithing
entries.summary: Rogues can turn polished gems into rings at Abel Armor Shop.
steps: Gather the recipe’s gem, labor, and crafting fee. Vorlof lists fees no higher than 5,000 coins per ring.
Speak to Steinar at Abel Armor Shop and choose “Smith Ring”.
Select the intended ring and complete the exchange.

entries.title: Generic stat plans
entries.summary: Use class and ability requirements to plan a character without importing anyone’s personal stats. The order of Constitution and Wisdom investment affects growth while leveling.
steps: Choose the abilities required before subpathing or mastery. Read their stat thresholds, prerequisite skills, and item requirements.
Use the generic source plans as starting targets. The five stats are listed in STR, INT, WIS, CON, DEX order; unspent points and Adoration rewards must be accounted for separately.

Raise Constitution or Wisdom early when their health or mana growth matters. Equipment can meet learning thresholds where the trainer permits it, but cannot substitute for explicitly required base health or mana.
Check the final allocation with the local planner and verify any equipment-dependent plan against the linked item records.

entries.title: Giant Floppy
entries.summary: Control Giant Floppy’s escape and regeneration while clearing its smaller companions.
notes: This tactics page gives the map reward as two million experience and 50,000 ability; Vorlof’s event page instead lists ten million experience. Both agree on 60,000 additional ability for the killing group.
The tactics page estimates seventy million health, 4,800 ability per small Floppy, and a 1% Pet Chicks chance. These are source claims, not fresh measurements.
steps: Enter Mileth Floppy Field at insight 99. Prepare aite and fas; group hide lets high-health players reveal first and take the smaller Floppys’ attention.
Clear nearby smaller creatures before pulling Giant Floppy to the group. Assign healing, dion, mana restoration, Cursed Tunes, Shock Arrow, and suain.
Keep Giant Floppy suained to prevent her escape, full heal, and additional spawns. She can attempt this sequence three times. Finish with light attacks or mor pian na dion at low health.
Collect the map reward and any personal drops. Exchange Mystery Eggs with Areini at Tagor Pet Store (17,45).

entries.title: Giant Mantis
entries.summary: Rescue Rennie during the Porte Forest quest.
steps: Bring three players total for Porte Forest, with one carrying Silver Wolf Leather.
The mantis becomes hostile shortly after appearing. Without the leather, its attacks can repeatedly reduce health to one.
Use dark attacks against elemental defense; Rogue damage traps and Warrior attacks are documented options.
After the transfer underground, speak to Rennie for Tristar Ring and Saved daughter of Porte Forest.

entries.title: Glading and marriage

notes: A breakup records a numbered Broke up with mark for the partners and a separate officiant mark.
steps: For glading, meet with a priest at Lover’s Glade in Enchanted Garden. Both partners receive a numbered Loves mark; the priest receives a ceremony mark.
For marriage, use a church in Mileth, Rucesion, or Tagor. Marriage replaces the current glade mark with Married; the pair can glade again afterward if desired.
To end the relationship, return with a priest. Use “Heartbroken” at the glade, or “Matrimony” then “Divorce” at a church.

entries.title: Gold Farming

Experienced characters can also provide leveling help, Hubae services, or gem polishing.

entries.title: Guild Castles
entries.summary: Guilds and fellowships can contest castles by defending their own piece and destroying the opposing one.
notes: A guild holding one castle cannot attack the other. A guild may attack twice in four hours. Castle ownership generates daily coins, and guildmates cannot damage each other during the battle. The source tentatively reports one damage per attack against the gate.
steps: An unoccupied castle costs 15,000 coins to attack and can be contested by several guilds. The first to reach and destroy the interior piece gains control.

An occupied castle costs two million coins to attack. Break the gate or climb ladders to reach the defending piece; ladders can deal substantial damage. Protect the attacking guild’s own piece outside.
Defenders receive a broadcast and can use NPC options to travel in and out. Protect the piece inside the castle.

entries.title: Hair utility reference
entries.summary: An archived desktop utility combining three configurable macros with a short stopwatch.
steps: The source maps F1, F3, and F4 to three saved combinations. Edit Settings.ini and restart the utility to change them.
F2 starts or dismisses the stopwatch. It closes automatically after twenty-one seconds.
The source credits Shynd for earlier DAHelp code. The downloadable program remains at the original source.

entries.title: Honor Field
entries.summary: Warriors can challenge a similarly leveled opponent in Honor Field.
notes: The winner receives 500,000 experience and 50,000 coins; the loser receives 100,000 experience. The same opponent cannot be fought consecutively. After five wins, the source’s progression trail ends with a referral to Vidar about Training Grounds.
steps: Choose an opponent within three levels. From Abel (44,64), reach the coast and enter Coast Bar (7,29). Say “Honor Field [your level]”.

entries.title: Hosted Arena

notes: Balanced Hosted Arena normalizes health and disallows Light Necklaces. Other restrictions vary by host. Participation can award experience, Arena Battles marks, and one Daily Quest Token per day; winners also receive Arena Victories.
steps: Respond to the broadcast and wait in the gauntlet. A host needs at least six players and may wait for a workable class balance.
Let the host finish team placement before raising balance concerns. Review the match’s rules before combat.
Start on the host’s signal. After defeat, go upstairs and resurrect through the NPC; remain for the rest of the match.

entries.title: How to Register
entries.summary: Registration unlocks additional game systems beyond free leveling.
notes: The source says free characters can reach level 99 and lists a 1,000-Kruna registration grant. Neither statement is a live account eligibility check.
steps: Vorlof describes registration as required for post-99 advancement and several social systems, including politics, religion, events, and hosted arena.
Other listed benefits include expanded communication, hairstyles, experience bonuses, ascension, and carrying equipment before it can be worn.

entries.title: Hunting for ability points
entries.summary: Medenian advancement uses ability points to unlock equipment and higher ability ranks.
steps: Advance along your main class’s Medenian path before building ability levels.
Choose a hunting area suited to your class, party, and equipment. The table gives Vorlof’s suggested AB ranges, not universal entry requirements.
Experience/ability bonuses can improve rewards from hunts, qualifying items, and quests.

entries.title: Hunting in Aman Jungle
entries.summary: Prepare different approaches for frogs, spores, and triggered Dendron spawns.
notes: The source’s suggested ability range is 30–54. It describes poison-trap hunting as another spore method; it is slower and still requires a safe position.
steps: Enter Aman Jungle 1 east of Aman Village. Frog rooms are 1, 13, and 17; spore rooms are 5, 9, and 16; Dendrons can trigger in 3, 8, 10, and 15.
Against earth-offense/earth-defense frogs, coordinate curses, elemental amplification, healing, and mana supply. Their assails drain health and mana, and attacking them can provoke Fright.

Spores have fire offense and earth defense. Wait for curse and fas to overlap, then strike decisively: below half health they flee while using group health/mana cups and poison. Sustained weak attacks can make the encounter much harder.
Dendrons also use earth elements but add sleep, blind, poison, and substantial drains. Frequent ao sith makes their debuff windows brief; Frost Arrow or Frost Strike can help.

entries.title: Hunting in Crystal Caverns
entries.summary: Manage short-distance pulls and hidden spikes while gathering Crystal Bars.
notes: The historical guide suggests ability 50–64. Its statement that no better higher-level hunting area exists is dated commentary and is not used as a current recommendation.
steps: Prepare for three earth-offense/earth-defense cave creatures in each room. Use curses, elemental amplification, healing, and coordinated damage.

Pull slowly enough to remain within two tiles of a pursuing creature. Greater separation can trigger 50% group health cups; Net removes another 2,000 health. Nearby players can take its attention, so keep the pull route clear.
Expect hidden spikes to remove 10% health. The guide estimates about 150 initial spikes per room, with used spikes returning in different places after roughly fifteen minutes.
Hunt stationary, nonattacking Crystal Shards for Crystal Bars used in Uniting the Chiefs. They have no element but substantial armor and health.

entries.title: Hunting in Hostile Grounds
entries.summary: Keep the group close and supported when engaging the three creatures in each room.
notes: Wanderlust recommends ability 40–54 and warns that higher levels reduce group gains. The exact reduction formula is not supplied.
steps: Complete Elemus Mount and enter its form. Reach Hostile Grounds from the northeast of Aman Jungle 10.
Prepare Cursed Tunes, elemental amplification, independent group healers, mana restoration, and damage/control roles. The documented creatures use earth offense and defense.
When a creature follows, remain within two tiles where possible and within healing range. Moving farther away can trigger repeated 50% group health cups; Net separately removes 2,000 health.
Coordinate debuffs and attacks while controlling the other creatures. Collect Clothing Scraps for Hostile Uniform.

entries.title: Hunting in Mileth Crypt
entries.summary: A level 1–98 dungeon with progressively stronger elemental spells and status effects.
notes: The guide highlights gems for learning abilities, Rogue treasure chests, and Succubus Hair for ascension.
steps: On the first two floors, creatures have no attack or defense element. An elemental belt and necklace provide an advantage.

From floor three onward, check the random basic element. Spellcasting begins on floor four; stronger spells appear deeper, alongside poison, blind, and suain. Bring suitable healing and status removal.
Use the map and creature records to distinguish passive spawns from aggressive variants. The most common low-tier creature is often passive unless already attacked.
At Crypt Chief Room, the lower passage returns to floor thirty. The left-wall portal at (1,15) leads to Mileth Inn.

entries.title: Hunting in Unknown Depths
entries.summary: Enter the underwater route from the passenger ship with Breath Ring equipped.
notes: Wanderlust describes the area as Master through ability 5. This is a hunting range from the guide, not a separately verified entry cap.
steps: Board the Temuair-to-Medenia Passenger Ship according to the desk NPC’s schedule. Equip Breath Ring and exit while traveling toward Medenia.
Curse high-armor targets such as Manta Ray, Sea Skrull, and Pirate Skeleton before committing damage.

An enemy surviving the first hit can remove your protective spells with ao sith. Further nonlethal hits can trigger several status spells together, including curse, poison, blind, and sleep. Prepare removal and healing before attacking.

entries.title: Hunting in Yowien Territory
entries.summary: The twenty-seven-map region opens in stages as its quest chain progresses. Creature behavior matters as much as the route.
notes: The tactics page names Aman Jungle 18 as the entrance, while other Wanderlust quest pages direct players to Ashlee in Aman Jungle 8. Vorlof’s quest route remains the primary guide.
Progression gates include the chiefs’ reunion, secured-cave access and Crystal Orb delivery, the waterfall route, and Yowien Costume. The source’s suggested hunting range is ability 40–80.
steps: Maps 1–2 contain frequent percentage-health traps plus frogs, Dendrons, and Sundews. Move with healing support. Map 3 is a documented Dendron hunting location without those initial trap rooms.

Check Yowien Trees from a distance. Hostile water-element trees react when approached within one tile, teleport beside their target, and repeatedly use Rumble. Passive non-elemental trees instead provide moss and sap.
Maps 12–14 contain Brutes, Baby Brutes, and fleeing Yowien Fish. Brutes can cross walls and drain health when a target moves over five tiles away. Baby Brutes attack much faster.

Maps 26–27 contain stationary vine trees that spawn many Yowien Sisters. Manage the sisters before surrounding the tree to limit further spawns. These trees are distinct from the earlier hostile trees.
Maps 15–23 contain successive Yowien/Yowie variants with frequent ao sith. Slow them and attack during the curse window. Hunt Grey Yowien Fur for the costume step.
Defeat ten White Baboons in map 24 to reach the boss room at 25. Keep the Chief and Thief phases distinct; the Thief’s Sundews sustain its healing.

entries.title: Hunting Tactics
entries.summary: Choose a party structure around the area’s danger, mobility, and debuff needs.
notes: Published rates depend on equipment, health, mana, skills, congestion, and balance changes. Vorlof explicitly warns that its experience-rate table may be outdated.
steps: A stationary box group uses a lurer to bring enemies to concentrated healing, mana supply, debuffs, and damage. A moving box keeps that support together while advancing through dangerous areas.
A damage dealer paired with a caster trades some defensive coverage for mobility and faster individual kills. Use skill cooldowns to gather the next target.
Caster pairs can improve spell throughput where control is less important; melee-only pairs must account for their limited debuffs.
Evaluate actual experience or ability over a measured interval with the intended group and bonus state.

entries.title: Law
entries.summary: Complete the final ability 50+ encounter in Discovered Lost Ruins.

Maintain dion and recover skulls quickly. Plan for repeated group mana drain and forced changes in facing. Avoid fas on the party: Law combines dark assails with a heavy light Fire Ring.

entries.title: Mastery
entries.summary: Mastery opens the next equipment and ability tier at insight 99. Choose whether to subpath first: becoming a Master makes that choice permanent.
notes: Initial abilities: Warrior receives Charge and Thrash; Wizard receives pian na dion; Priest receives mor dion comlha; Monk receives Iron Skin; Rogue receives Assassin Strike and Midnight Slash.

Wailen in Oren teaches Cyclone Blade, Triple Kick, or Stab Twice by class. Pure-only options include Mad Soul/asgall faileas, Whirlwind Attack, and Shadow Figure. The Shinewood 11 fairy teaches fas spiorad to Wizard Masters and deo searg gar to Priest Masters, with Wings of Protection or deo searg for the corresponding pure path.
steps: Meet the class-specific base health, mana, and ability requirements in the table. Check without equipment. Every class also needs two hundred million experience.
Ask Aoife at Temple of Choosing about “Master”. Complete her initial requirements check before preparing the master item.
Hunt the two class materials in Cthonic Remains and bring them to the listed crafter. Return the finished item to Aoife through the class’s Master dialogue.
Aoife consumes the item and experience, announces mastery, and grants the class’s master weapon, clothing, and initial abilities.
Continue to the four Creant quests. Masters can also buy stat points for 150 health per point, using ascension to replace health when available.

entries.title: Medenian advancement
entries.summary: After the four Creants, advance within your main class along its Medenian path and begin earning ability levels. Ability level, insight level, and individual skill ranks are separate systems.
notes: Pure-only books include Intimidate for Gladiator; Mana Ward and Disenchanter for Summoner; Salvation and Cursed Tune for Bard; Puncture for Druid; Volley and Set Volley for Archer.

Feral emphasizes individual skill damage with longer cooldowns; Komodas offers a larger health bonus and short cooldowns; Karura provides area attacks with substantial mana demand. Consult the ability records for exact ranks and costs.
Pantica and Borim, used for early abilities, drop in Noam Plains. Missing health or mana entry thresholds are not invented: the source specifies a consumption cost instead.
steps: Have all four Creant defeat marks and 250 million experience. Advancement consumes 500 base health and 500 base mana and removes Master and Grandmaster equipment. Arrange replacement equipment before confirming.
Visit Lenoa at Asilon (30,29) and select “The Training Room”. Ask Inia about “The paths of Medenia”, then choose “Join your path” when ready.
Enter your class’s training room. Druids must first choose Feral, Komodas, or Karura; the source describes this form choice as permanent.

Learn Learning Spell from the trainer for 10,000 coins and buy the books for the abilities you plan to learn. Cast Learning Spell from the Medenian spell bar, opened with Shift+D, and type the exact ability name and rank.

Learn the initial weapon-enabling ability listed below. Its first rank costs the corresponding book and one million coins. Obtain entry clothing from Juwerl at Asilon Weapon Shop (12,29), listed at 100,000 coins.
Earn ability from eligible creatures or reward items, then learn stronger ranks. Medenian ranks replace their earlier version; they do not create a separate spell for every rank.

entries.title: Medenian Chests
entries.summary: Use regional keys to open chests around Asilon Prairie.
notes: Documented outcomes include Kanna Metal Necklace, Jeweled Nature Belt, Silk Boots, Spear Arrow, 50,000 coins, loss of 100,000 coins, ten ability, or reduction to one health. The source does not provide outcome probabilities.
steps: Collect Red Key, Marble Key, Love Key, or Leaf Key from creatures around Asilon and Noam.
With keys in inventory, attack a chest from an adjacent tile to attempt opening it.

entries.title: Medenian Ferry
entries.summary: Travel between Loures and Medenia by scheduled ferry or eligible express passage.
notes: The source labels its schedule PST and contains a mismatch: its prose lists an 11pm ticket sale but a noon departure. The schedule is historical source data, not a live timetable.
steps: Buy one ticket per voyage from Quard at Loures Harbor Shop during the hour before departure. Board through the NPC’s menu.
The crossing lasts forty minutes. The captain’s cabin avoids the dangerous sea creatures encountered outside.
Check “Schedule” or wait for the arrival announcement, then choose “Exit Ship”. With Breath Ring equipped, exiting mid-voyage instead leads to Unknown Depths.
Aislings on a Medenian path can use the instant Express Ship for 50,000 coins. After arrival, travel north through two maps and use the waygate toward Asilon.

entries.title: Medenian spirit worship
entries.summary: Choose Earth, Water, or Fire independently of Temuair religion.
notes: The source lists no Wind Spirit and no distinct general advantage from choosing one of the three available orders.
steps: Visit EarthSpirit in Noam, WaterSpirit at Water Temple, or FireSpirit in Hwarone. Speak to the spirit and repeat its chant to join.
Repeat the appropriate chant every three hours to attempt to raise reverence.
As reverence increases, join the unlocked mass types. Mass can be performed every three days and may require other participants.

Additional source credit: Snooze — college reference contributions.
steps: Attend classes to obtain Educated marks. Spend three marks to enter the Contest Hall and submit a Dark Ages-focused work in Art, History, Literature, Lore, Philosophy, or Persona.
Check eligibility with a College Chancellor. The source bars entry after more than one jail or arrest record. Obtain feedback before submitting, because submitted work cannot be modified.
Post the work’s link in the Contest Hall. Previous nobles review it; voting normally lasts one week and can be extended for insufficient reviews. KRU supplies the final result.
After the tentative award is confirmed, visit the appropriate NPC to claim its permanent mark and associated rewards.

Eligible active nobles with Village or higher awards, excluding Persona, can teach. A class needs at least twelve students for chances at Tentative Noble Garment marks, which Jean in Loures Library exchanges for garments.

entries.title: Religions of Temuair
entries.summary: Join a Temuair faith to pray, build faith, and request deity-specific effects.
notes: The eight Temuair faiths are distinct from the three Medenian spirits. The source does not describe ordinary worship membership for Chadul or Danaan.
steps: Arrange initiation with a religious priest and receive the faith’s Prayer Necklace and prayer spell.
Cast prayer, drop the necklace on the casting tile, and immediately pick it up to open the options. You can also pray with a temple attendant.
Give thanks to build faith, use supplications or entreaties to spend it, or praise another worshipper to transfer faith. Entreaties cost more faith but can be used from a lower faith threshold.
Consult the deity’s allies and enemies before praying at another temple. Allied temples can also accept prayers.

entries.title: Religious Ranks
entries.summary: Advance from worshipper through religious offices with class, award, and initiation requirements.
notes: Higher offices can initiate, banish, excommunicate, and grant geas to lower ranks. Summoning uses the spell and necklace procedure, with creatures determined by faith and religion.
steps: Find a priest of the intended faith, meet at its temple, and complete any initiation tasks. Accept “I enter [religion] Fellowship” to receive the necklace and prayer spell.
Below level 11, the rank is Probate and geas is unavailable. Worshippers can pray; Acolytes gain summoning and lesser desecration through assistance from a higher role.
For religious Priest and higher offices, the character must also be of the Priest class. Religious Priests can create prayer necklaces, desecrate items, and hold mass.
Cleric requires a Clave award and 40 initiates alone or 20 with higher-role assistance. Minister requires Village award and 80/40 initiates. High Priest requires Village award and 160/80 initiates.

entries.title: Sapphire Stream
entries.summary: Earn Dugon training through eligibility, a timed hunt, and meditation.
notes: Training unlocks the matching Dugon crafting and relevant abilities. Teacher and student roles are often called Sabonim and Hubae.
steps: Meet the color’s level and prior-student requirements. Both teacher and student should have full labor. A teacher can teach eligible colors below their own rank.
The student says “Sabonim, Please teach me the [color] dugon”, chooses a teacher by name or the solo option, and accepts the assigned hunt.
Kill the named creature within three hours. A teacher can help, but the student must land the final blow.

Return and repeat the teaching request. Enter the meditation room to the right, approach the correct colored stone, and choose the response from the meditation reference. A wrong answer requires restored labor before retrying.
After the “Aha!” confirmation, leave and say “Sabonim, I understand the [color] dugon”. Receive the training mark; the teacher receives a numbered Sabonim mark.

entries.summary: Prepare the ascension prerequisite and materials before beginning the subpath ceremony.
notes: The full subpath guide controls the required experience, class thresholds, reset consequences, and final choice. This short checklist does not replace those requirements.
steps: Obtain a qualifying citizenship through mentoring and Respected Citizen, or the Tagor citizenship quest.
Gather ten ard ioc deum and complete the appropriate Aisling equipment route; the source’s example uses 25 Finished Talos for level-97 armor.
Ascend as needed to meet the class’s health and mana requirements, then begin the subpath process.
Use the 24-hour dedication period to finish eligible ability training before returning to complete the transition.

entries.title: Subpathing
entries.summary: Subpathing is an optional choice at insight 99, before mastery. Change your class to combine abilities learned in two paths, or remain on a pure path and proceed directly to mastery. The decision resets your level and changes which pure-only abilities remain available.
notes: Subpathing must happen before mastery. Mastering closes this option. Learning an omitted former-class ability later may require a separate Learn Skill/Spell Scroll rather than its original trainer.
steps: Decide which class you want to finish in. Learn the skills and spells you want to retain from your current class before completing dedication. Pure mastery instead preserves access to that class’s exclusive abilities and equipment.

At insight 99, remove equipment and check base health and mana against the current-class requirements. Bring sixty million experience and ten ard ioc deum. Aisling of Talgonite unlocks ascension when more base health or mana is needed.
Visit Aoife at Temple of Choosing and select “Class Dedication”. She takes the potions when admitting you, so check requirements before entering.

Speak to the NPC inside, choose the new class, and receive the temporary dedication mark. Wait at least twenty-four hours. Use this interval to finish learning abilities; the change waits until you return.

Return through Aoife and confirm the final choice. Insight becomes 1, each base stat becomes 3, and health and mana become 100. Up to nineteen unspent stat points carry over. Previously learned abilities remain.

entries.title: The four Creants
entries.summary: Defeat Tauren, Lady Phoenix, Medusa, and Shamensyth to earn all four marks required for Medenian advancement. “Grandmaster” describes this stage of progression rather than a separate class.
steps: Complete each Creant’s quest chain and defeat its boss. The four routes travel through different hostile regions, so prepare suitable equipment and support for each.
Keep all four defeat marks. Each class receives equipment from three Creants and a mark without an equipment reward from the fourth. Pure and subpath equipment rewards differ.
When ready, use the four marks to qualify for your Medenian path.

entries.title: The world of Dark Ages
entries.summary: Dark Ages combines character progression and cooperative combat with a society shaped by its players.
steps: The five Temuair paths are Warrior, Wizard, Priest, Monk, and Rogue. Their Medenian successors add another layer of class abilities.
Quests, hunting, equipment, crafting, politics, and religion are connected systems. Choose a path, then follow its learning requirements and progression milestones.
Community histories, philosophy, literature, and art also form part of the world. The bibliography credits the original writers and directs readers to their work.

entries.title: The world of Temuair
entries.summary: Temuair’s setting is shaped by the loss of Hy-brasyl, dangerous magic, and recurring struggles between Light and Dark.
notes: This is a short independent synopsis of the setting history attributed by Vorlof to Seanchas Temuair, Volume 1, in the Library of Loures. The full narrative remains at the linked source.
steps: The setting’s history begins with Hy-brasyl’s prosperity and its collapse as elemental power becomes a tool of conflict. Survivors establish new societies, but warfare and experiments with Darkness bring further catastrophes.
Chadul and the dubhaimid threaten mortal life, while Danaan becomes a focus of resistance. Later political struggles involve Tenes, the Anaman pact, Ainmeal, and the rise of Loures.
Under Ealagad, the struggle continues through the Shadows War. Rucesion’s discovery of Light helps defeat the forces of Darkness, leaving the world in which Aislings adventure.

steps: Finish the Yowien Territory quests and bring Yowien Costume. Prepare aite and fas, clear nearby Brutes with wind attacks, and position around the group healer. A lesser beag cradh on the group can block the stronger encounter curse.
Have a durable player lure Yowien Chief from the room’s center. Use Cursed Tunes, Frost Arrow, Shock Arrow, and mor pian na dion. The Chief can also be cursed and fassed for light attacks.

When the Chief dies, Yowien Thief appears on an adjacent tile. Continue the damage and slowing rotation, but stop casting curses: its ao sith removes Cursed Tunes and Frost Arrow, allowing rapid regeneration.
Manage the summoned Sundews. Each living Sundew helps heal the Thief; leaving one can prevent another full spawn.

steps: Use an insight 99 character and speak to Nadia or Aidan beside the tables at Mileth College (24,27).
Receive VDay Bonus Exp-Ap(x5), providing five documented hours of double experience and ability.

entries.title: Yule Logs
entries.summary: Craft and deliver a Yule Log to each of six inns.

facts.label: Rewards

notes: The event can repeat after twenty-four hours.
steps: Ask Torbjorn at Suomi Weapon Shop (11,54) about “Yule Logs” to borrow Torbjorn’s Axe.
Hunt trees in Mount Giragan 1–3 for twelve Cedar Log and twelve Fir Log. Return them to Torbjorn for six Yule Log.
Obtain six fior srad. Rogues can buy them at Black Market.
Bring one Yule Log and one fior srad to each inn in Mileth, Abel, Rucesion, Piet, Tagor, and Suomi. Say “Yule Logs” at every inn.
Return to Torbjorn and select “Yule Logs” for three Double Bonus Exp-Ap, nine million experience, level-scaled ability of 20,000–450,000, and the numbered crafting mark.

entries.title: Zombie Apocalypse
entries.summary: Assemble a Skeleton Buddy from escaped zombies’ bones.
steps: Hunt Walking Zombies in Mileth, Undine, Abel, Piet, Tagor, Suomi, Rucesion, or House Macabre. Collect Zombie Tibia, Femur, Ribs, Radius, Ulna, Humerous, Clavical, Pelvis, Skull, and Fibula. A temporary zombie form can interrupt attacks; wait or replace it.
Say “Zombies Escaped?” and “Zombie Bones” to Dislaidir at House Macabre (4,12).
Bring Raw Wax, Dirk, and Wooden Shield with the bones. Enter the eastern stairs at Mileth Crypt entrance (11,2), then follow the east wall of Sgath Pit to the secret doorway at (11,1).
At Gigean’s Dwelling (7,7), say “Zombie Bones” and “I have all the items”. Wait five minutes, then ask “Are you done Gigean?” for Skeleton Buddy and twenty million experience.

entries.title: Zombie Slayer
entries.summary: Survive fifteen increasingly difficult waves in Macabre Grave Yard.

facts.label: Rewards
facts.value:
"Zombie Slayer Record: Round #, # zombies slayed"
Zombie Defender
55,000,000 Experience
Ability

evidence.value:
"Zombie Slayer Record: Round #, # zombies slayed"
Zombie Defender
55,000,000 Experience
Ability

notes: Vorlof lists Zombie Defender at 7,500 damage per second, ignoring armor, spells, and invincibility.
steps: Form a group with four pets and the roles in the encounter table. Ask Dislaidir at House Macabre about “Zombie Slayer” to enter.

Survive the waves through round fifteen. Zombie attacks use a percentage of health, so fas, aite, and dion do not provide their usual protection; lower maximum health also reduces the healing needed to restore it.
After returning to House Macabre, choose “Update Zombie Slayer Record”. Improving the recorded round or kill count grants five million experience.
Choose “Zombie Slayer Prize” for fifty million experience, Zombie Defender, and the record mark.

tables.title: Reference details
rows: Attack the zombies with light attacks.

Make sure the mor ioc comhla has mana at all times.
You may also be required to flower the light attackers.
Curse the zombies so they take increased damage from light.
fas the zombies so they take increased damage from light.

During Eulogy, visit the event mundane at Pravat Prole Ground (35,15), Mehadi Heart East (5,15), or Astrid Center (20,15). Collect the local keepsake and legend mark.
During Redemption, return to the same mundane to upgrade the keepsake and obtain the Redemption mark. Keep the upgraded item.

For Adoration, form a three-person group representing all three locations. Each participant must carry their upgraded keepsake. Meet at Pravat Prole Ground (35,15); one participant begins the dialogue and supplies the other two names.
Complete the ceremony for +2 to every attribute, 100 HP, 100 MP, and the Adoration of Danaan mark.

entries.title: Aided the Pact of Anaman
entries.summary: Choose the harmful branch of the Loures sick-child storyline.
notes: This branch prevents completion of Cured a Sick Child in Loures.
steps: Find Paulin in Loures Cyril Corridor and discuss the child.
Collect five Tulsi Blossoms from Mehadi Heart West (11,3). Flower gathering is limited to one per day; accumulated flowers can be submitted together.
Return to Paulin. Select “The sick child, how is she?” and offer Tulsi Blossom twice in the dialogue.
Each offering gives 10,000 experience. Five offerings award the Aided the Pact of Anaman legend mark.

entries.title: Aisling of Hy-brasyl
entries.summary: Use a top contest award and a finished Hy-brasyl gem to obtain an ascension-enabling legend mark.
steps: Earn the highest award for a contest entry.
Obtain one Hy-brasyl Fragment from an Unseelie Satyr in Cthonic Remains. Have a Rogue polish it to Finished Hy-brasyl; budget roughly two days of labor.
Wizards, Priests, and Rogues visit Moire in Great Sylvan Glade, reached from East Woodland 20-1. Warriors and Monks visit Torgny in Ancient Dwarven Cave, reached from Abel Dungeon 10-2.
Choose your class armor, select the smithing option, and choose Hy-Brasyl. Confirm the final crafting dialogue.
Receive level-97 armor and the Aisling of Hy-brasyl mark, which permits exchanging experience for HP or MP through ascension.

entries.title: Aisling of Mythril

5x Mythril Shield (of same god)
Mentored 200 Players

evidence.value:
5x Mythril Shield (of same god)
Mentored 200 Players

steps: Complete 200 mentoring sessions and collect five Mythril Shields dedicated to the same god.
Wizards, Priests, and Rogues speak with Moire in Great Sylvan Glade via East Woodland 20-1. Warriors and Monks speak with Torgny in Ancient Dwarven Cave via Abel Dungeon 10-2.
Select your class armor, the smithing dialogue, and Mythril; confirm crafting.
Collect level-97 armor and the Aisling of Mythril mark. The mark unlocks the experience-to-HP/MP ascension process.

entries.title: Aisling of Talgonite
entries.summary: Craft Talgonite armor to earn the legend mark needed for ordinary HP and MP ascension.

facts.label: Items Required

5x Finished Talos
Respected Citizen*
*Or Tagor Citizenship

evidence.value:
5x Finished Talos
Respected Citizen*
*Or Tagor Citizenship

notes: Aisling of Hy-brasyl, Aisling of Mythril, and Peasant Day provide alternative routes to the qualifying mark.
steps: Become either a Respected Citizen or a Tagor Citizen.
Gather five Talos Fragments from Dark Clerics in Cthonic Remains or the lower-level Loures Maze. A Rogue must polish them into five Finished Talos; allow approximately one or two labor loads.
Wizards, Priests, and Rogues use Rowena in Singing Sylvan Glade, reached through East Woodland 20-1. Warriors and Monks use Torgny in Ancient Dwarven Cave, reached through Abel Dungeon 10-2.
Select your class armor, enter the smithing dialogue, and choose Talgonite. The experience cost is 50 million at level 97–98 or 100 million at level 99.
Confirm crafting to receive level-97 armor and the Aisling of Talgonite mark. You can then exchange experience for HP or MP through ascension.

entries.title: Andor Trials
entries.summary: Clear nine cooperative trials to gain Andor Dungeon access.

facts.label: Items Required
facts.value:
Mantis Mask
Mantis Costume
1,000,000+ Coins
4 Additional Players

evidence.value:
Mantis Mask
Mantis Costume
1,000,000+ Coins
4 Additional Players

facts.label: Rewards
facts.value:
"Explorer of Andor Dungeon"
Broken Andor Shield

evidence.value:
"Explorer of Andor Dungeon"
Broken Andor Shield

notes: Relogging ejects you. Budget for retries. Riddle answers by clue: neighbors who cannot see one another—Eyes; cut head and tears—Onion; food versus water—Fire; running with mouth/head/bed—River; coveted beaten metal—Gold; successive beheadings—Stable; king of shovels—Spades.
steps: Group only the participating players. In Andor Lobby, wear Mantis Mask and Mantis Costume, then pay DungeonAnt 1,000,000 coins. Equip the supplied Magic Lantern.
Room 1: go north, take the first left portal, then travel south to the exit. Room 2: place a member on every teleport square. Room 3: regroup in the center before heading north.
Room 4: cross the collapsing bridge. Two strong members can clear the far end; reaching it advances the group. Defeat the ordinary ants before attacking Guardian Master.
Room 5: follow the mapped crossing and remove obstructing guards. Room 6: assail chess pieces to push them in your facing direction; occupy matching plates to remove pillars.
Room 7: click gravestones only while they face south. Protect and heal the group against the statues.
Room 8: defeat all five Guardian Statues and occupy the teleport tile beneath each. Avoid hiding, which triggers ao sith.
Room 9: assail the central piece for a riddle. Enter its answer with an initial capital and no final period; cancel and retry for another riddle if necessary.
Collect the Broken Andor Shield and Explorer of Andor Dungeon mark.
rewards:
"Explorer of Andor Dungeon"
Broken Andor Shield

Defeat 12 opponents in the first room, 14 in the second, and 19 in the third. Each defeated creature returns stronger until its room is complete.
Finishing the third room returns the group to the entrance and awards a Champion Band, Tortoise Mount, and Arena Circut Champion mark.

notes: Unequipping a replica during the fight can kill the entire group. Relogging in Decimated Village returns you to East Woodland 20-1 (25,25).
steps: Start with Muhsin in Mileth Restaurant. Search the Crypt Chief Room below Mileth Crypt 30-2 for footprints; avoid (1,15), which sends you home. Report to Muhsin.

Consult Blaise in Loures Library about the statue, Deos in Oren Throne Room, then Thibault in Loures 3 Floor Office. Trigger the event when leaving; ask Yves in Loures Underground Jail about “Note From Servant”. Return to Deos.

Pay Baldo at Oren Sewers Entrance one million coins for “Oren Tombs”. Enter Oren Island Upstairs0 from (33,94), then the tomb at (2,8). Obtain all four distinct, soulbound Oren Relics. Use (6,40), then approach Donal’s coffin at (17,20) for Path to Feasgar.
Enter the Grasslands from East Woodland 20-1 (49,49). In Grassland Village, accept Ceannard’s task at (59,37), kill five Kobolds, and return. Enter Caladh Beithir at (43,99).
Follow the Caladh route reference. Every member needs six Dust Cloud kills, eight Cave Shadow kills, a Sub-cavern Key, 20 Speleo kills, and ten Gargoyle kills before reaching Feasgar Village.
Travel through Feasgar Village (58,0) and Feasgar Kingdom (32,0). Speak to Feasgar at (21,14). In Mileth, consult Dar, then Devlin, then Dar again about “Feasgar’s Curse”.

A level-41–71 character can search Karlopos for Brato’s event, documented near the north corner of Island 3-C. Stop moving when it appears, enter, and listen to Brato for a Coral Pendant. The pendant is tradable, so eligible players can obtain one for higher-level members.
At Noam Sacred Grounds, speak near EarthSpirit: “Hello”, “Earth Gem”, “Yes”, then “King Octopus”. Every participant needs one Earth Gem and one Coral Pendant.
At the rock formation in Karlopos Island 1 4-C, take the class positions shown on the map. The Monk takes position last and advances the dialogue to move the group into the trap room.

Move through the traps in single file and avoid walking along a horizontal trap row. Revive fallen members before advancing and give healers time to recover. Clear the following creature rooms in sequence.
At the final gates, stand from left to right as Warrior, Rogue, Wizard, Priest, then Monk. Surround King Octopus; it flees and casts poison. Its elemental defense favors curse, fas, and dark attacks.
After the fight, speak to Mireh in New Coast Back Yard. Surrender the Coral Pendant and Earth Gem to claim Sea Coral Necklace, five million experience, and the completion mark.

entries.title: Eingren Manor
entries.summary: Investigate an abandoned manor through a sequence of keys, diary pages, and demon encounters.
notes: Room encounters reset after about five minutes. Avoid accidentally leaving a room after a key has been consumed. The source contains extensive story text; this guide focuses on the route and encounter requirements.
steps: Bring a Shovel from Nobis and a Deoch-consecrated Wooden Shield. From Tagor Tavern, head left to the raft at (73,10). Equip the shovel and search Anwar Farm (20,27) for Diary Page 1.
Cross Filth 4 through the guest house at (64,3), leaving the house at (10,0). Continue through Filth 5 (52,0), Filth 6 (52,0), and Filth 7 (10,0). Enter the Abandoned Church from Filth 8 (52,42).
Drop the shield beside Dreval at (9,2) for Manor Key. Enter Manor Steps from Filth 8 (42,0), continue at (0,0), then enter the main hall at (12,12). The key is consumed.
Take the second hallway. Follow the route table, collecting every key and diary page. In room 86, walk around to trade the complete diary collection to Frankford.
In room 99, say “Shila” for Headmaster Key. Bring the group through the final route to floor 2-20 and defeat Shila for Headmaster Note. Each additional player’s key permits another encounter.

Return to the main hall and take the third hallway to 3-16. Enter room 193 at (27,48), consuming Headmaster Note. Hunt the shadows for Crystal Balls; the source estimates roughly two to four per hour.
Go to 3-20 and physically drop one Crystal Ball onto the table. Defeat the summoned headmaster for Demon Orb. Repeat as needed, using one ball per encounter.

Return through the first hallway to 1-3 and accept the event. It consumes a Demon Orb even if you subsequently cancel. Defeat Demon Headmaster for Demon Lord’s Notes. For further fights, another orb holder can re-enter while the remaining group waits inside.

entries.title: From the Heart
entries.summary: Investigate Bella’s disappearance, then choose a paired ceremony or a solitary Heart of Stone.
notes: The paired branch gives both participants a named Fire/Moon legend mark, level-dependent experience, and permission to cast aite in Loures Jail. The solo branch gives Heart of Stone and experience, but no jail aite permission. Documented level-25 examples are 800,000 experience for Fire and 450,000 for Moon.
steps: A registered character needs either a partner or one Conix Fragment. Speak to Marlin in Loures Underground Jail (19,4), choose “From the Heart”, ask about Bella, and agree to deliver his message.

Visit Jean the Councillor in Loures 3 Floor Magic Room. Discuss “Cycle of Becoming”, “Theology of the Conjunction”, Bella’s whereabouts and words, his feelings, and Marlin’s release. Avoid “Even if it would damn others”.
Visit Enchanted Garden (80,7). When the scarf event appears, choose “Wait”, then agree to leave Faerie Wine (Beothaich Deum). Ask the faerie about Bella and where she is now.
Report the faerie’s account to Marlin and accept the next task and message.

Approach the beds in Loures 1 Floor Bed Room near the restaurant. Choose “Feel it” at the stone event to enter Dark Maze. Search around the doors in its four rooms for another stone event and touch it to enter Heart of Stone. Different level brackets can enter different mazes.

Paired branch: the Fire participant stands at (5,5), selects “Conjunction of the Flame & the Moon”, and enters the Moon participant’s name. The Moon can stand elsewhere. Continue the ceremony without choosing “*cough*”, which restarts it.
Solo branch: choose “Heart of Stone” and “I am sure”, using one Conix Fragment.

Each bunch contains five Cherry and grants 500 experience. Approximately six bunches can be harvested before Goran asks you to leave.

Go to the cotton field (70,60), kill a Lorai, and search for the green-liquid event. Collect Mysterious Potion.
Report to Jedas, then consult Kabok in Noam (45,62).
Eliminate every Lorai in Asilon Town. They originate in the cotton field but can wander elsewhere. Check with Jedas until he confirms completion.

entries.title: Lost Ruins Grimes

Return to Braishi for 50 million experience and 50,000 ability.

Return to Cronan for five million experience and 5,000 ability.

Both players find a Red Rose in Enchanted Garden, then return together to Alane.
Both find a Golden Rose in Loures Castle’s Lovers Garden and return.
Both find a Black Rose in Tagor Farm, entered at (73,10), and return.
Both find a White Rose in Shinewood Forest Entrance, then return to receive Love Bouquet and 100,000 experience.

Travel through Lost Ruins to the path at (3,35) into Lost Ruins 4. Gather a group with seal, fas, group hide, and strong wind damage such as Keeter or Hail of Feathers.

Speak to the fountain at (12,11) for 850 health and 850 mana.

Collect Fire, Sea, Earth, and Wind Hy-brasyl Belts. Their documented sources are Goblin Guard in East Woodland 15-1, Shrieker in 19-1, Hobgoblin in 18-1, and Hobgoblin in 17-1 respectively.
At level 99, take the materials to Dobol in the trees on Mount Giragan 18. Choose “I’m listening” and accept the crafting exchange for 100 million experience.

entries.title: Pentagram
entries.summary: Coordinate five classes through a timed pact, two exchanged clues, and a final banishment.
notes: First-clue recipients: Wizard→Warrior, Monk→Rogue, Warrior→Priest, Rogue→Wizard, Priest→Monk. Second-clue recipients reverse those exchanges.

Equipment: Warrior—Scarlet Chitin Helm and Scarlet Carapace; Wizard—Lich Hood and Lich Robe; Priest—Dark Cleric Brim and Dark Cleric Robes; Monk—Nagetier Jaw and Nagetier Cloak; Rogue—Kopfloser Hood and Reiter Mail.
steps: Form a five-player group with one of each class. Everyone must share a bracket: 60–69, 70–79, 80–89, 90–98, or 99+. Bring full labor and two Zombi’s Flesh from House Macabre Yard 1. The pact lasts three hours.

Meet in Loures Library. One player opens the tome at (6,4), chooses “Gather five aislings and sign the pact”, and enters each member’s name. Each must sign before the next name is entered. Memorizing the grimoire at (6,9) costs labor and permits later pacts elsewhere.

Enter the northern house at Macabre Yard 1 (8,8), then Pentagram Room at (1,13). Take the initial class positions in the table. The Wizard drops one Zombi’s Flesh at (7,16). A successful invocation gives each player Altar Candle.

Move two skulls clockwise. Call up the assigned creature, follow its conversation, and ask where the indicated area is. Record the complete location clue and send it to the previous occupant of your new tile.

Visit the location from the clue you receive. Ignore unrelated events. Call up the correct creature and record its second clue, then send it back to the player who supplied your first clue. Have the Warrior obtain this clue first: Vorlof reports that a destination in Macabre Yard 2 breaks the quest, requiring the pact to expire before restarting.
Visit your second assigned location and complete its conversation until instructed to return to the pentagram.

Everyone returns to the original positions. Prepare buffs, then the Wizard drops the second flesh at (7,16). If a creature appears, allow it to take a step before killing it; killing too quickly can prevent credit.

After the kill, resume the original positions. The Wizard picks up the flesh and drops it once more at (7,16). Each player receives 2.5 million experience, Altar Candle, and class-specific armor and headwear.

Vorlof reports a bug allowing Ponytail without materials. That report is not evidence that the requirement remains waived.

Collect that style’s materials, return to Eeva, select the same hairstyle, and confirm “Yes I did”.

steps: Tell Maria Christine at Plamit Village (40,18) that you fight for “Myself”. In Plamit’s Cave 1-1, 2, or 3, kill ten Baem Gaedeu and collect five Wind Baem Missives per party member. Report back.
Accept the second proving task. In Cave 4-1, kill five Baem Gaedeu and ten Baem Soldata, and gather five Silver Baem Egg per person. Report and wait three hours.

Collect the Gadeu promotion from Julia and speak to Maria. Complete missions 4–6, observing the three-hour limits on missions 5 and 6.

After the demotion to Dum’Drazul, show Julia ten Uncut Hy-brasyl, which are not consumed. Next give her ten Finished Hy-brasyl, which are consumed. Speak to Maria, then provide Julia two Conix Fragment.

Speak to Maria for Partially Decoded Missive. Use it to solve the substitution puzzle. Its message identifies Julia as a hostile thrall and warns her controller to handle interactions with Aislings carefully. Report to Maria.
Say “Please” to FireSpirit at Hwarone Fire Spirit Temple (48,98), then to WaterSpirit at Water Spirit Temple (16,9). Gather two Lily Pads, two Kobold Tail, two Dochas Bloom, and one Cactus Flower.
Say “Please” to EarthSpirit at Noam Sacred Grounds (88,0) for Pouch of Soil. Bring it and the flowers to WaterSpirit through the same command. Wait three hours and return for Curative Potion.
Speak to Maria and give her one Rock Fish. After three hours, collect Delightful Meal. Speak to Julia to cure the curse, then to Maria for Soldata of the Ancient Flame.
Complete mission 7, report to Maria, and wait three hours. Return for Sinturi of the Ancient Flame, Satchel of Goods, and boss-room access. This also unlocks Baem Missive Decoding.

entries.title: Poisonous Antidote
entries.summary: Collect Black Scorpion Stings for Pila’s antidote.
steps: Accept Pila’s request at Excavation Camp (12,8).
Search Deadwood Forest 1–7 and kill Black Scorpions until you have ten Black Scorpion Sting.
Return the stings to Pila for 200,000–500,000 experience, depending on level.

entries.title: Porte Forest
entries.summary: Obtain Turuc Pendant before level 41, cross the trapped path, and rescue Rennie.

facts.label: Rewards
facts.value:
"Saved daughter of Porte Forest"
+
"Eased the suffering of Porte Forest"
(Or a Tristar Ring)

steps: Say “Porte Forest” to Torbjorn at Suomi Weapon Shop (11,54). Cross the bridge near (97,24) into Porte Forest and collect four Trent Root per participant from Tree Demons.

If the group needs Silver Wolf Leather, gather five Silver Wolf Mane Hair from Silver Kobolds in Porte Forest 4-L, 4-C, or 4-R. Giant Ant Wings absorb one path trap each; the source recommends six per player for groups smaller than three.
Return the roots to Torbjorn through “Porte Forest”. If making the leather, say “Skin” to Bertil at Suomi White Magic Master (15,86), then give the resulting armor to the tank.
Re-enter the forest and search Porte Forest 4-R (11,25) for Turuc Pendant. Obtain it before reaching level 41; later forest access does not remove that restriction.
With the pendant, enter Porte Forest Path north of 4-C. Carry at least six Red Potions per person. Move in a line, revive fallen members promptly, and watch for two adjacent traps near the middle.
Recover in the Peak Waiting Room. When ready, one member enters the next room to move the group into the Giant Mantis encounter.

Use dark attacks against its elemental defense. Silver Wolf Leather protects against its repeated reduction to one health. After the fight, speak to Rennie underground for Tristar Ring and Saved daughter of Porte Forest.
Optional: give Tristar Ring to Lureca in Porte Forest Shop for one million experience and Eased the suffering of Porte Forest. You can return later through Porte Forest 3-C.

entries.title: Pravat Quests
entries.summary: Support a Pravat faction through offerings and enemy defeats.

facts.label: Items Required

Flawed Gems
Finished Gems
God Items
Conix Stone

evidence.value:
One of the following:

Finished Gems
God Items
