notes: Without an alliance, both sides attack. The source reports that temporary hostility can clear with time or after killing ten different creature types.
steps: If desired, choose an alliance with Evan at Pravat South Entrance (25,16). An alliance cannot be changed for three Temuairan days, or nine real hours.
For the Goblins, visit Bahadir at Pravat West Entrance (11,19). For the Grimlok, pass through Pravat Shallow (35,14) and enter Pravat Heart at (49,33) to reach Phailin.
Use the appropriate offering dialogue or report defeated enemy types. Recent attacks against a faction can prevent its NPC from speaking to you.

entries.title: Recovered the Arcane Gauntlet
entries.summary: Follow the Rucesion clue in Demon Lord’s Notes to expose the assassins and recover the gauntlet.
notes: Documented passwords include spypost, sinful, backstab, and garotte; use the password actually assigned to you.
steps: Read Demon Lord’s Notes in Rucesion, then explore until the whisper event appears. Record its password.

Go alone behind Mileth Church to (39,67), with no other players visible, and say the supplied password. In the Assassin’s Hall entrance, remain silent when speaking with Nikolad, then accept his assignment.
Return after one week to collect the Plain Black Box. Use it near the Beggar at Pravat South Entrance while no other players are visible.
Report to Nikolad, then search the Beggar’s location at (16,16) for his journal. Follow its clue to Tagor’s armor shop and search around (44,29) for the Dusty Glove.
Take the glove to Nikolad. Defeat Andante, Barnedo, and Calidus before finishing Nikolad and his demon form.
Attempt to enter the hall. The closing dialogue awards the Arcane Gauntlet and its recovery legend mark.

entries.title: Recovered the Obsidian
entries.summary: Open a monk puzzle, equip an expedition, and recover Obsidian from a demon.
notes: The source lists an additional Obsidian and the Recovered the Obsidian mark on completion. Bring adequate healing and combat support.
steps: Obtain Demon Lord’s Notes from Eingren Manor or another player. Read them in Suomi, then search the town for Monk Puzzle Box.
Opening the box requires at least 130 intellect. A trusted eligible player can open the tradable box for you. Read the Monk Puzzle Paper before it disappears.
Enter Tagor Church (65,29) and approach (16,1). Lift the floorboards and descend. Ask Garamon about the place, listen, and agree to help.
Bring his requested supplies. The fixed list is two Finished Ruby, one Empty Bottle, and one Shovel; additional requests may include Whip, Parchment Scroll, Rum, Rose Bouquet, or Kobold’s Skull.
When asked for Eleven Foot Pole, ask why it is needed. Visit Goran at Suomi Cherry Farmer (15,72), choose “Eleven foot pole”, and return after three days to collect it.
Return to the church basement and enter the opened passage. Pursue the demon until it collects Useless Obsidian, then defeat it, collect Obsidian, and escape before the collapse.

entries.title: Reforged the Eclipse
entries.summary: Restore an unusual blade through two long waiting periods and a demon fight.

facts.label: Items Required
facts.value:
Demon Lord's Notes
100x Finished Talos
30x Trent Root

evidence.value:
Demon Lord's Notes
100x Finished Talos
30x Trent Root

steps: Read Demon Lord’s Notes, then explore Chaos 1 until you discover a Brittle Blade.
Say “Strange Blade” to Torbjorn at Suomi Weapon Shop (11,54). Leave the blade with him and wait one week.
Supply 100 Finished Talos and 30 Trent Roots. Materials can be handed in incrementally through repeated dialogue.
After the materials are complete, wait another week. Enter the basement at (2,1).
Defeat Pater, whose low-health behavior includes poison and blindness. Open the chest for Eclipse and its legend mark.
Return to Torbjorn if you want to finish the conversation; the source documents truthful, deceptive, and silent responses.

entries.title: Reincarnation of Chadul
entries.summary: Follow the Sgrios branch of the Acolyte Ordeal and interfere with the Tree of Light.
notes: The source mentions a third caravan response without documenting its outcome; only the two described branches are included.
steps: Bring a Mask, a travel song such as Mileth Song, and 30,000 coins. Ask Ereno at Rucesion Church (11,11), inside (18,2), about “Acolyte Ordeal” and choose the Sgrios/Chadul branch.

At Gramail Shrine, Loures Castle Way (9,18), ask Camille (3,4) about “Acolyte Conspiracy” and donate 10,000 coins. Escort the caravan and obtain Mortair Hideout Map: defeat the thieves after “Prepare to die”, or join the guild and search the hideout. Use the map and report to Camille.

At Fiosachd Shrine, Abel Port Way (9,6), speak to Audny (3,4) through the same conspiracy option and donate 10,000. Within three minutes, collect payments from Alane at Oren Jewelry Shop, Areini at Tagor Pet Store, and Gudny at Suomi Restaurant. Return to Audny.
At Ceannlaidir Shrine, Piet Village Way (8,7), speak to Erika (3,4), donate 10,000, and kill ten Goblin Warlords in Grass Battle Field. Report for the Sgrios referral.
At Sgrios Shrine in Dubhaim, ask Greim (3,4) about the conspiracy. Complete the assigned arena player kill and report the victim’s name with exact capitalization. Receive the vial.
Enter the log in Shinewood 20 (23,5). The Tree of Light sends you home without a death pile. Return to Greim for Dark Shield.
Re-enter, equip the shield, and face the tree with the up direction to block its damage. Reach (19,6), click the tree, and apply the vial.
After returning to Shinewood Entrance, report to Greim for Chadul Reincarnation and Rest Cloak.

entries.title: Reincarnation of Danaan
entries.summary: Follow the Deoch branch of the Acolyte Ordeal and interfere with the Tree of Darkness.

facts.label: Items Required
facts.value:
Fishing Rod
Fishing Bait
Engagement Ring
110,000 Coins

evidence.value:
Fishing Rod
Fishing Bait
Engagement Ring
110,000 Coins

notes: The stated starting coin total exceeds the three explicit 10,000-coin donations. The remaining budget is not itemized in this guide. Vorlof gives Oren Jewelry Shop as (88,17) here but (88,117) elsewhere; use the linked shop record.
steps: Prepare Fishing Rod, Fishing Bait, Engagement Ring, and the source-listed 110,000 coins. Ask Ereno at Rucesion Church (11,11), inside (18,2), about “Acolyte Ordeal” and choose Deoch/Danaan.
At Luathas Shrine, Rucesion Village Way (9,6), ask Gabriela (3,4) about “Acolyte Conspiracy”, donate 10,000 coins, attend a Mileth College class, and report back.

At Cail Shrine, Undine Village Way (9,6), speak to Evania (3,4) through the same option and donate 10,000. Fish at Abel docks until three old cauldrons have been credited, then report. Fishing supplies are sold at Abel Fish Market (26,46).

At Glioca Shrine, Mileth Village Way (10,19), speak to Meaveen (3,4), donate 10,000, and accept the lovers task. Ask Muhsin at Mileth Restaurant “About Alane”, then Alane at Oren Jewelry Shop “About Muhsin”. Tell her you have spoken to him, report to Muhsin, and return to Alane with Engagement Ring. Report to Meaveen.
At Deoch Shrine, Suomi Village Way (10,6), ask Vivianne (3,4) about the conspiracy. Use the supplied Deoch Potion to revive ten players, then return for the vial.
Enter the grove in House Macabre Yard 4 (17,5). The Tree of Darkness sends you home without a death pile. Return to Vivianne for Light Shield.
Re-enter with the shield and face the tree using the up direction. Reach (19,6), click the tree, and apply the vial.
After being returned to Road to House Macabre, report to Vivianne for Danaan Reincarnation and Rest Cloak.

entries.title: Religious Geas
entries.summary: Arrange a geas with a player priest of your religion.
steps: Join a religion, then find a religious priest who belongs to the same faith and is willing to conduct a geas.
Meet at the faith’s temple and complete any tasks the priest assigns. The ceremony depends on player participation, so its requirements can vary.
Completion grants “Completed religious geas for [name]” and 100,000 experience.

entries.title: Riona's Greeting
entries.summary: Receive Riona’s welcome after leaving the tutorial.
steps: Speak to Riona at Mileth Inn and choose “Riona’s Greeting”.
Continue with “Thank you for your kind words.” and “Really, I want to know.”
Finish the conversation for 500 experience and directions to the Training Quest.

entries.title: Shamensyth Creant
entries.summary: Assemble Blazing Wand from two jester encounters, then summon Shamensyth.
notes: Avoid pressing F5 on the jester summoning portals, which can summon additional enemies. Warriors receive the legend mark only.
steps: Say “Enter Sewer Maze” to Filippo in Tower 1-1, entered from Oren City (36,50).
For each wand, obtain one Red Shocker Box Piece from Shockers in Sewer Maze 9, and two Blue plus one Gold Shocker Box Piece from Shockers in Sewer Maze 11. Reserve 300,000 coins for repair.

Use the summoning portal in Sewer Maze 12 to fight Anolipo, the Yellow/Blue Jester, for Lower Blazing Wand Piece. At Sewer Maze 8’s portal, fight Jalipo, the Red/Blue Jester, for Top Blazing Wand Piece.
Take both halves and 300,000 coins to Uliam at Nobis Weapon Shop (50,25). Choose “This broken staff.” to create Blazing Wand.
Return to Sewer Maze 14 and use its portal to summon Shamensyth. Control its damage with sleep traps, suain, beag suain, or Paralyze Force; dioned protects against the fiery meteors.
Collect Shamensyth Mask and return to the summoning portal for the completion mark and class-dependent equipment.

steps: Visit Callough at Mileth Weapon Shop (13,68) with fewer than 1,000 coins. Choose “Spare a Stick”, then “I’ll gather them now” to enable branch collection.

entries.title: Spores
entries.summary: Gather red and grey spores for Merrell at Aman Inn.
notes: Both plant types have fire offense and earth defense.
steps: Speak to Merrell at Aman Inn (66,44) and accept the gathering task.
Hunt Red Spore Plants and Grey Spore Plants in Aman Jungle 5, 9, and 16 for ten Red Spore and ten Grey Spore.
Return the twenty spores for 50 million experience and 100,000 ability.

steps: Reach AB40 and complete the Aman Jungle quests. Accept Jowella’s request at Yowien Territory 3 (21,25).

Hunt material-bearing Yowien Trees in Territory 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, or 11. Collect ten Yowien Tree Sap and ten Yowien Tree Moss. Group members can receive drops directly in inventory, with a greater chance for the killer.

entries.title: Tagor Citizenship
entries.summary: Earn one-time Tagor citizenship by protecting its citizens from skeletons.
notes: Tagor Citizenship satisfies the citizenship requirement for Aisling of Talgonite. The source also mentions clearing recent accidental hostility by killing ten creature types, but that does not establish that an existing murder legend can be removed.
steps: Renounce existing citizenship before starting. Do not proceed if the character has already earned Tagor citizenship or has the conflicting citizen-murder record.
At Tagor Inn (40,50), ask Dorina through “Tagor Welcome” and “I wish to become a citizen of Tagor”. Receive Belladonna.
Enter Lost Souls Pass at (0,35), eat Belladonna, and personally land the final blow on five Tagor Skeletons. Avoid attacking the villagers.
Return to Dorina and repeat the citizenship dialogue to complete the exchange.

entries.title: Talk to Mileth Mundanes
entries.summary: Earn experience by listening to the Mileth trainers’ explanations.
notes: These listed lessons total 7,000 experience. Registered Wizards and Priests can also discuss Graymere; registered Priests can discuss Entreaties. Registered characters can seek additional experience by discussing the gods with a temple attendant. This is a standalone game quest, separate from the excluded new-player guide.
steps: At Mileth Armor Shop, ask Torrance about Weapons, Armor, Clothing, Jewelry, Magic, and Items Found. The complete Arms set awards 1,250 experience.
At Mileth White Magic Master, ask Devlin about the Woods for 2,000 experience and Faerie Love for 1,500.
At Mileth Combat Skill Master, ask Keallach about Group, Tactics, and Weapons for 2,250 experience.

entries.title: Tauren Creant
entries.summary: Obtain Tauren Horn and Nose Ring from two independent encounters, then summon Tauren.

facts.label: Items Required
facts.value:
Full:
Nothing
Final:
Tauren Horn
Tauren Nose Ring

evidence.value:
Full:
Nothing
Final:
Tauren Horn
Tauren Nose Ring

notes: Monks and Rogues receive the legend mark only. Warriors choose a one-handed or two-handed weapon.
steps: Complete the Kelberoth and Goblin General stages in either order. No initial offering items are required.
Enter Kelberoth Ice Caves from Mount Giragan 21. Find and read the stones throughout the rooms; their initial letters spell Kelberoth. Say “Kelberoth” in Ice Cave 4 to summon it.
Defeat Kelberoth for Tauren Horn. Most spells do not hit it; Maiden Trap, Zombie Defender, or melee damage can work. Paralysis, poison, or sleep can trigger Dire Wolf spawns.
At Mount Giragan 24, speak to Gridak near (50,8) to enter Goblin Ice Caves in disguise. Remove monster transformations first, as they can interfere with the disguise.
Speak to Hogor in Ice Cave 18, then Ridush in Ice Cave 16. Defeat the two summoned guards and collect Throne Key from the Goblin Warlord. Return to Hogor for Goblin Hy-brasyl Gauntlet.
Take the key and gauntlet to Ice Cave 22. Entry consumes the key. Approach the throne to summon General Prugar and defeat him for Tauren Nose Ring. Spells work against this encounter.
Enter the southern-wall caves on Mount Giragan 12 and reach the last room. Approach the ice prison to summon Tauren. Avoid status effects if possible, since they can trigger additional images.
Defeat Tauren, collect Tauren Hoof, and return to the ice prison for the completion mark and applicable equipment.

Review the class descriptions and choose the path that suits the character you want to develop.
Plan the later route before mastery: at level 99, a character can remain pure or subpath into another Temuairan class. Mastery and Medenian advancement follow their own requirements.

entries.title: Terror of the Alley
entries.summary: Form a small party to confront the beggar’s nightmare in Abel Alley.
notes: Completion grants two health, one mana, 25,000 experience, and the numbered Slew Terror of the Alley mark. The quest repeats after 12 hours. Completing another Terror branch replaces the previous branch’s legend mark.
steps: Walk around Mileth Tavern to trigger the beggar’s conversation and give him 1,000 coins. Ask “What do you mean by terror of sleep?” and follow the options confirming that you and your companions are ready.

Enter the second participant’s name. That player accepts with “I am, and so are my companions.” and enters the third name. For a two-player group, the second player can enter the first player’s name again.
After receiving the location, visit Abel Port (6,40) to trigger entry into Abel Alley.
Entry grants 5,000 experience. Defeat the nightmare creature and leave the encounter area to collect the completion reward.

entries.title: Terror of the Crypt
entries.summary: Form a small party to confront the beggar’s nightmare in Mileth Crypt.
notes: Completion grants two health, one mana, level-dependent experience, and the numbered Slew Terror of the Crypt mark. The quest repeats after 12 hours. Completing another Terror branch replaces the previous branch’s legend mark.
steps: Walk around Mileth Tavern to trigger the beggar’s conversation and give him 1,000 coins. Ask “What do you mean by terror of sleep?” and follow the options confirming that you and your companions are ready.

Enter the second participant’s name. That player accepts with “I am, and so are my companions.” and enters the third name. For a two-player group, the second player can enter the first player’s name again.
Enter Mileth Crypt at (93,54), descend from Crypt 1-1 at (5,5), then head toward Crypt 2-1 (40,40) to enter Shrouded Crypt.
Entry grants 5,000 experience. Defeat the nightmare creature and leave the encounter area to collect the completion reward.

entries.title: Terror of the Garden
entries.summary: Form a small party to confront the beggar’s nightmare in Enchanted Garden.
notes: Completion grants two health, one mana, 25,000 experience, and the numbered Slew Terror of the Garden mark. The quest repeats after 12 hours. Completing another Terror branch replaces the previous branch’s legend mark.
steps: Walk around Mileth Tavern to trigger the beggar’s conversation and give him 1,000 coins. Ask “What do you mean by terror of sleep?” and follow the options confirming that you and your companions are ready.

Enter the second participant’s name. That player accepts with “I am, and so are my companions.” and enters the third name. For a two-player group, the second player can enter the first player’s name again.
Walk through Enchanted Garden from (20,96) toward (30,96) to trigger Seelie Ground.
Entry grants 5,000 experience. Defeat the nightmare creature and leave the encounter area to collect the completion reward.

entries.title: The Beast of Deadwood
entries.summary: Find and defeat the beast hiding in Deadwood’s brambles.
steps: Choose “The Beast of Deadwood” with Wihelm at Excavation Camp (6,11) and agree to help.
In Deadwood Forest 5, walk through the bramble square near (11,26) until the beast appears. Defeat it.
Return to Wihelm through the same quest option for one million experience.

entries.title: The Letter
entries.summary: Follow a shared investigation with one male and one female character.

notes: Both receive random Sonnets, Bouquets, or Sweethearts, a possible Eternal Love Ring, and 10,000–400,000 experience. The repeat interval is four days. First NPCs include Duana, Riona, and Frida; second NPCs include Marlon, Thibault, and Jay.
steps: Both participants visit Aingeal at Mileth Tavern (69,54), inside (6,5). The male starts “The Letter” and chooses “I have a lady friend whom she might talk to”; the female accepts with “Yes, I’ll find the cause”.
The female receives the first NPC’s name. Visit together, remember this NPC for the final return, and have the female say “The Letter”.
Visit the second NPC named to the male. The male says “The Letter” and receives directions to Baltasar.
At Rucesion Special Skill Master (9,34), the male says “The Letter” and asks his companion to speak. The female asks about the letters and where they are.
In Loures Library, the female searches (1,14), asks the male for help, and reads each letter once. Choose “Memorize the letters and leave”, then “Hide the letters and leave now”.
Return together to the first NPC. The female says “The Letter” to finish.

entries.title: Thibault
entries.summary: Offer a Stilla to Thibault.
steps: Buy Stilla from Loures 1 Floor Weapon Storage for 11,800 coins.
Speak to Thibault in Loures 3 Floor Office (11,4). Choose “You grace me with your protection”, then “Offer a sword”.
The Stilla is consumed and you receive 70,000 experience.

entries.title: Throttler's Wife
entries.summary: Find a response to Throttler’s request for a wife.
steps: Accept Throttler’s favor at West Woodland 12-1 (21,20).
Say “Throttler Wife” near the eligible Mileth NPCs: Riona at the inn, Aingeal or Duana at the tavern, Oona at the restaurant, or Devlin at White Magic Master.
When one provides Throttler’s Letter, return it to Throttler for 100,000 experience.

entries.title: Tiota Quest
entries.summary: Complete three random assignments for a Tiota necklace.
notes: Tiota’s properties are random. Completion grants no experience. The note delivery to Baltasar requires dropping the note on him.
steps: Enter the Empty Building at Tagor (37,13) and search the back of the room for the quest event. After chaos, the event may take about one hour to respawn.
Complete each assigned task and return before beginning the next. Use the specific target and location in the assignment.
After the third task, inspect the nearby chest for Tiota and the Completed Tiota Quest mark.

entries.title: Trade Merchant
entries.summary: Trade a starting item through Medenia until you obtain Square Jewelry Box.
notes: If the trade item is lost or you want to restart, “I Lost the trade item” costs 500,000 coins.
steps: With Hwarone access, ask Lau at Hwarone Bank (68,65) about “Trade Merchant” and agree to begin.
Take each trade item to the matching recipient in the table. Repeat with the new item received.
Return Square Jewelry Box to Lau for 7,000 ability.

entries.title: Training Quest
entries.summary: Complete the early combat exercise offered by the trainer named Vorlof.
notes: A lure-the-wolf option exists, but this source only documents the combat branch. The trainer is an in-game NPC; this entry does not reproduce an individual player’s character record.
steps: Visit Mileth Training Room (17,84) before passing level 11. You need level 3 to equip the required Wooden Shield.
Agree to train and choose “Kill a wolf”. Buy a Dirk for 500 coins and Boots for 1,000, then return and confirm.
Buy Wooden Shield for 100 coins, return, and confirm again.
Kill a Spider on Mileth Crypt 1-1, entered from Mileth near (91,54), and report to the trainer.
Enter the Cow Pen at Mileth (33,20), kill a Wolf, and return for Eppe and 5,000 experience.

entries.title: Treas Quest
entries.summary: Complete three random tasks for a Treas necklace.
notes: There is no experience reward. Vorlof reports that the Royal Chicken task may complete by dropping the chicken and speaking to the quest giver again, instead of the stated delivery to Lia.
steps: Search the rear of Tagor’s Empty Building (37,13) for the quest event. It may take about one hour to return after chaos.
Complete each assigned task and report back to receive the next.
After all three, open the nearby chest for Treas with random properties and the Completed Treas Quest mark.

steps: Every participant needs Breath Ring. In Loures Harbor Shop 2 (5,31), enter the tavern at (0,11) and approach Creeg. Say “Hello” twice, “Where?”, “Who are you?”, “I am [name]”, “sits”, “What Happened?”, and “Sure” for Tablet Piece 1.
Buy passage to Medenia and board. After departure, equip Breath Ring and choose “Exit Ship” to reach Unknown Depths 1.
Collect one Starfish Arm per person. At Shell Home in Unknown Depths 8, tell Qualen “Tablet”, then “Seafood” to exchange the arm for Tablet Piece 2.
At the north corner of Unknown Depths 9, say “Tablet” to Donn, listen, then say “Burgess”, “Seagull”, and “Propose” for Tablet Piece 3.

Say “Tablet” to Keily in the seashell shop in Unknown Depths 12 for Piece 4. Enter Depths 14 to combine the pieces into Ship Tablet. Do not leave this area before proceeding; the source warns that you cannot re-enter.
Enter Wrecked Ship Floor 1 at (29,17). Collect the sequential keys and follow the special floor-2 and floor-5 instructions in the table.
At Wrecked Ship 5-7, approach Maryla (6,6) and say “Maryla”, “Donn”, “He is dead”, then “He will always love you”. Choose or collect the ore allowed for your class.
Leave and re-enter Unknown Depths by exiting the passenger ship again. Take the ore to Keily in Depths 12 to craft the corresponding item.

entries.title: Water Dungeon
entries.summary: Meet each floor’s kill requirements, manage repeated enemy cleansing, and defeat the four pillars.
notes: Kills generally count across the map, but the source reports extra credit sometimes going to the final-blow player. One person’s final-floor entry command moves the group.

Creature threats: Anemone Faeries drain group mana; Doscidicus rapidly apply percentage damage; Naupilus drain mana and use Intimidate; Sea Rams attack rapidly and steal mana; nearby Sirens apply group sleep. Vorlof credits Viral for Water Dungeon notes.
steps: Build a group with sustained healing and mana supply, curse support, Cursed Tune, and suitable damage. Groo also needs fas support; Hail of Feathers benefits from curses. Bring Wake Scrolls.

All ordinary enemies have water offense and defense. Use earth offense or Groo, with dark, light, or earth defense. Avoid poison and sleep, which can fully heal enemies. Frost Strike and Frost Arrow reduce their cleansing frequency.

On each floor, kill five of every creature that can spawn there. Move deliberately across platforms to trigger encounters. Keep the group together and let a durable player test tiles before casters move.
Prioritize Anemone Faerie, Doscidicus, Naupilus, Sea Ram, Jellyfish, then Siren. Keep Sirens distant to avoid group sleep. Refresh debuffs after enemies use ao sith.

Near the fountain, say “Water Spirit, I have done what you have asked of me” to advance. To leave early, say “Water Spirit, I cannot continue, I must rest”. Check that the least-credited player can advance before the principal killers leave.
Floor 14 has a one-hour deadline before kill counts reset. A disconnected player may return with fewer credited kills; clear the area before they reconnect.
On floor 15, defeat all four pillars. Each pillar and the final return can award Water Dungeon Chest. Speak to WaterSpirit afterward for additional ability.

steps: Accept Throttler’s favor at West Woodland 12-1 (21,20).
Obtain ten Wolf’s Skin from Wolves in West Woodland, East Woodland, or Astrid. A Rogue can also obtain them through Higgling.
Return the skins for 15,000 experience.

entries.title: Work for Tybar
entries.summary: Complete Tybar’s two-hour pest hunt for ability points.
notes: These are Vorlof’s preferred values. Wanderlust lists lower rewards of 5–15 ability.
steps: Ask Tybar at Asilon Canteena (42,25) about the pests and agree to help.
Within two hours, kill five of the specific creature he names.
Return for the target’s ability reward. The assignment is repeatable.

notes: Norrie requires a fresh Crystal Orb after seven days. Use the spoken entry commands; the doors at Norrie and Luwella do not perform the transfer.
Vorlof reports a chance for the bouquet or braided vine to break, while questioning whether vine breakage still occurs. Replacement braids require ten Blue Vine and ten Yellow Vine.
Jowella is listed at (26,25) here and (21,25) in Strong Winds. The coordinate discrepancy is retained.
Wanderlust recommends leaving the Crystal Caverns by recall after obtaining the Crystal Orb: spike traps can break it. Gather twenty Yowien Fishes in areas 12–14 before returning to Luwella.
The side exits from Yowien Territory 14 lead north to area 27 for Yellow Vines and east to area 26 for Blue Vines. Wanderlust lists one or two vines per tree.
steps: Reach AB40 and complete the Aman Jungle quests. Speak to Kharlo in Crystal Cave 7 (15,5), then enter Yowien Territory from Aman Jungle 18’s southwest wall.
Tell Jowella in Territory 3 “I know Kharlo”. Tell Kharlo “Jowella is mad at you”, tell Jowella “He is apologizing”, then ask Kharlo “What is her favorite flower?”.

Gather twenty Dendron Flower. Say “Dendron Bouquet” to Kheven in Territory 6 (5,36), wait ten minutes, and repeat the command. Equip the bouquet and ask Kharlo to inspect it through the same phrase. If it breaks, gather another set. Give the approved bouquet to Jowella through “Dendron Bouquet” for 85 million experience and 550,000 ability.

Tell Kharlo “She forgives you”, hear the complete conversation including the sleeping dialogue, then click him for access to Crystal Cave 8. Continue to Cave 14 and obtain Crystal Orb before Rock Scorpion Miners destroy the targets.
Speak to Norrie in Territory 11 (35,5), then say “Crystal Orb”. Ask Luwella in Territory 5 (7,10) “Why are you crying?”. Ask Lizbeth in Territory 4 (52,27) about “Yowien Fishing Pole”.

Say “Let me through” to Norrie. Hunt twenty Yowien Fish in the waters of Territory 12–14, then tell Lizbeth “Yowien Fishes” for the pole. Equip it and search those waters for Luwella’s House Key. Return it through “I have the house key”.
Ask Luwella “Can I come in?”, then say “Hello Granny” and “I can protect Luwella”. Kill forty Baby Brutes in Territory 12–14. Return with “I am all done” and “Wake up Granny!”.

Collect twenty-five Yowien Blue Vine from Territory 27, northeast of 14, and twenty-five Yellow Vine from Territory 26, southeast of 14. Tell Granny “I have the Vines” for Yowien Braided Vine. Enter Territory 14’s waterfall to reach 15.
Ask Arcella in Territory 15 (13,24) “What are you doing here?” and “What useless junk?”. Bring twenty Yowien Grey Fur, say “I have the Grey Yowien Furs”, then “Secret Language”.
Equip both Yowien Costume and Yowien Headgear. Say “graauuloow” to the guard in Territory 17 (29,7), then continue to Chief Guard in Territory 24 (45,25).

Wait for the full group, then kill ten White Baboons. They attack within two tiles and hit rapidly; maintain healing and defensive support. The documented approach uses Cursed Tune and mor pian na dion on one target at a time.
Enter Territory 25 and defeat both boss forms. After the first falls, its disguise breaks and the second appears. A successful fight can award Arcella’s Stolen Bag1.
Return the bag with “I have your stolen bag”, then “Are you done yet?” for Arcella’s Gift1. For later bags, use “I have another stolen bag”. Alternatively, open the bag for experience and ability.
